We are looking for a PhD student in computational interaction to join our group at HPI.

PhD Position in Computational Interaction at Hasso Plattner Institute, University of Potsdam

Are you interested in human-computer interaction, user modeling, and machine learning? Join us as a PhD student in Computational Interaction at Hasso Plattner Institute to develop computational approaches that help build more intelligent, adaptive, and human-centered interactive technology.

Read more and apply here:
Feel free to forward it to anyone who might be interested.
